RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Registry canonical project export: the same 100 in a different text format and order. Logical hash = registry baseline_hash.

RESEARCH_ONLY_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL (one genuine swap; far below the five-swap owner-presentation floor, so NOT owner-presentable). +Bitterblossom / -Mist-Syndicate Naga. No owner keep or owner addition is cut (Naga is a plain retained Ninja, not among the owner's named keeps). Mana base, land count (33), U/B/R sources (25/21/21) and paid turn-3 UBR castability (0.6668 play) are unchanged; Spellbook combos 5 -> 5; Game Changers 6 -> 6. Bounded Pass C ledger: Bitterblossom >= Naga in 9 of 10 scripted rows (Dragons), loses only lean flyer-wall. MODERATE confidence; no matched games.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; Pass C's exact requested alternative A). Bident of Thassa is an explicit owner keep and drew 2-23 cards across the bounded rows; cutting it loses the deck's per-creature combat draw engine for a token maker. Evidence does not clearly beat the owner keep.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; Pass C's exact requested alternative B). Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar drew 2-11 cards across rows and rescues blocked attackers (re-castable fresh entrants); highest-synergy EDHREC card in the list (0.60 general). Not clearly worse than Naga, so it is not the cut.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; the deep review's named 3-4 MV example). Frostcliff Siege's Temur mode gives every creature (including Bitterblossom Faeries and Dragons made later) haste and trample, and its Jeskai mode is a Grazilaxx-style draw engine; it directly supports the fresh-attacker plan, unlike Naga.

REJECT_LARGER_PACKAGE (two-swap, staged). +Redoubled Stormsinger -Frostcliff Siege on top of the research swap. Stormsinger makes zero Dragons in every lean row (needs tokens that entered this turn) and its copies are sacrificed; Frostcliff's haste is what lets fresh tokens attack. Marginal: not counted.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (two-swap, staged; not counted). +Rapid Hybridization -Vandalblast. One-mana instant removal for a flying blocker (the scenario where Bitterblossom alone fails) versus the deck's only cheap artifact sweeper; a role shift with MODERATE-LOW confidence, so not a genuine improvement.

REJECT (two-swap, staged). +Dragonskull Summit -Crumbling Necropolis. Overrides the owner's mana-base keep; exact castability of paid turn-3 UBR drops 0.6668 -> 0.6654 because the tri-land's blue is lost (untapped timing not modelled). Not clearly better.
